kjv: The LORD our God [is] one LORD
mine: Yahweh is our God, Yahweh alone
note: The verbless Hebrew YHWH 'eloheinu YHWH 'echad can be parsed several ways: "Yahweh our God, Yahweh is one" (unity) or "Yahweh is our God, Yahweh alone" (exclusive loyalty, fitting the following call to undivided love); the KJV takes the oneness reading.

kjv: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God
mine: You shall not put Yahweh your God to the test
note: Hebrew nissah means to test or try someone (cf. massah, "testing"); "tempt" now suggests enticing to sin.
